outcome_summary: Implemented two DiffWindow UX improvements: a draggable `GridSplitter` between the diff list and the recommendations sidebar (with sidebar width persisted to `AppConfigModel`), and collapsible guidance cards with chevron indicators (each card independently toggled and persisted across sessions). All acceptance criteria were met; the existing test suite passed with zero regressions.
project_summary: This project adds two UX improvements to the DiffWindow in the Starfield Load Order Keeper application. A draggable GridSplitter allows users to resize the diff list and recommendations sidebar panels, with the chosen width persisted across sessions. It also introduces collapsible sidebar guidance cards with chevron indicators, where card states are independently toggled and persisted, and the Removed Mods card starts expanded by default.
